CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pos_sale_commit(_sale jsonb, _items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, _payments jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, _movements jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, _member jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, _exchange_bill text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  s jsonb := COALESCE(_sale, '{}'::jsonb);
  entry jsonb;
  existing_id uuid;
  movement_result record;
BEGIN
  IF NULLIF(s->>'id', '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(s->>'bill_number', '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_SALE: id and bill number are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO existing_id FROM public.sales
   WHERE id = (s->>'id')::uuid
      OR (NULLIF(s->>'client_transaction_id','') IS NOT NULL
          AND client_transaction_id = s->>'client_transaction_id')
   LIMIT 1;
  IF existing_id IS NOT NULL AND existing_id <> (s->>'id')::uuid THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION: attempt already belongs to sale %', existing_id
      USING ERRCODE = '23505';
  END IF;

  -- A sale and its tender rows both reference the attached member. Upsert the
  -- parent first so a member created on this device can be used immediately.
  IF _member IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(_member->>'id','') IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.members (
      id, member_code, full_name, phone, email, address, date_of_birth,
      tier_id, loyalty_points, total_spent, updated_at
    ) VALUES (
      (_member->>'id')::uuid, _member->>'member_code', _member->>'full_name',
      COALESCE(_member->>'phone',''), NULLIF(_member->>'email',''),
      NULLIF(_member->>'address',''), NULLIF(_member->>'date_of_birth','')::date,
      NULLIF(_member->>'tier_id','')::uuid, COALESCE((_member->>'loyalty_points')::numeric,0),
      COALESCE((_member->>'total_spent')::numeric,0), now()
    ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
      member_code = EXCLUDED.member_code, full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
      phone = EXCLUDED.phone, email = EXCLUDED.email, address = EXCLUDED.address,
      date_of_birth = EXCLUDED.date_of_birth, tier_id = EXCLUDED.tier_id,
      loyalty_points = EXCLUDED.loyalty_points, total_spent = EXCLUDED.total_spent,
      row_version = members.row_version,
      updated_at = now();
  END IF;

  IF existing_id IS NULL THEN
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.promotions p
      WHERE p.id::text=s->>'coupon_promo_id' AND p.promo_type='code'
        AND (p.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM true OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
          OR upper(btrim(p.title)) IS DISTINCT FROM upper(btrim(s->>'coupon_code'))
          OR COALESCE(p.code_scope,'bill') IS DISTINCT FROM s->>'coupon_scope'
          OR (NULLIF(p.code_cluster_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.stores st WHERE st.id::text=s->>'store_id' AND st.group_id=p.code_cluster_id
          )))
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REUSABLE_CODE_NOT_VALID: refresh the code and check its store coverage'; END IF;
  
    INSERT INTO public.sales (
    id, bill_number, member_id, store_id, shift_id, cashier_name,
    subtotal_amount, total_amount, discount_amount, tax_amount, payment_type,
    payments, points_earned, points_redeemed, is_exchange, original_bill_number,
    exchange_credit, paid_amount, change_amount, is_refunded, coupon_code,
    coupon_promo_id, coupon_scope, coupon_discount, client_transaction_id,
    store_name_snapshot, store_address_snapshot, rounding_adjustment,
    rounding_label, authorization_request_id, authorized_by, authorized_at,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    (s->>'id')::uuid, s->>'bill_number', NULLIF(s->>'member_id','')::uuid,
    NULLIF(s->>'store_id',''), NULLIF(s->>'shift_id',''), NULLIF(s->>'cashier_name',''),
    COALESCE((s->>'subtotal_amount')::numeric,0), COALESCE((s->>'total_amount')::numeric,0),
    COALESCE((s->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0), COALESCE((s->>'tax_amount')::numeric,0),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s->>'payment_type',''),'cash'), COALESCE(s->'payments','[]'::jsonb),
    COALESCE((s->>'points_earned')::numeric,0), COALESCE((s->>'points_redeemed')::numeric,0),
    COALESCE((s->>'is_exchange')::boolean,false), NULLIF(s->>'original_bill_number',''),
    COALESCE((s->>'exchange_credit')::numeric,0), COALESCE((s->>'paid_amount')::numeric,0),
    COALESCE((s->>'change_amount')::numeric,0), COALESCE((s->>'is_refunded')::boolean,false),
    NULLIF(s->>'coupon_code',''), NULLIF(s->>'coupon_promo_id',''), NULLIF(s->>'coupon_scope',''),
    COALESCE((s->>'coupon_discount')::numeric,0), NULLIF(s->>'client_transaction_id',''),
    NULLIF(s->>'store_name_snapshot',''), NULLIF(s->>'store_address_snapshot',''),
    COALESCE((s->>'rounding_adjustment')::numeric,0), NULLIF(s->>'rounding_label',''),
    NULLIF(s->>'authorization_request_id','')::uuid, NULLIF(s->>'authorized_by',''),
    NULLIF(s->>'authorized_at','')::timestamptz, COALESCE(NULLIF(s->>'created_at','')::timestamptz,now())
    ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(_items,'[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.sale_items (
      id, sale_id, product_id, product_name, variant_code, unit_price, unit_cost, quantity,
      discount_percent, discount_amount, tax_rate, is_return, is_foc,
      promo_id, coupon_code, coupon_discount, created_at
    ) VALUES (
      (entry->>'id')::uuid, (s->>'id')::uuid, NULLIF(entry->>'product_id','')::uuid,
      entry->>'product_name', NULLIF(entry->>'variant_code',''),
      COALESCE((entry->>'unit_price')::numeric,0),
      COALESCE((entry->>'unit_cost')::numeric,0), COALESCE((entry->>'quantity')::integer,1),
      COALESCE((entry->>'discount_percent')::numeric,0), COALESCE((entry->>'discount_amount')::numeric,0),
      COALESCE((entry->>'tax_rate')::numeric,0), COALESCE((entry->>'is_return')::boolean,false),
      COALESCE((entry->>'is_foc')::boolean,false), NULLIF(entry->>'promo_id',''),
      NULLIF(entry->>'coupon_code',''), COALESCE((entry->>'coupon_discount')::numeric,0), now()
    ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  END LOOP;

  FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(_payments,'[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.payment_transactions (
      id, client_transaction_id, source_type, sale_id, booking_id, member_id, store_id, shift_id,
      terminal_id, amount, method, kind, reference, cashier_id, cashier_name,
      note, paid_at, created_at, status, metadata
    ) VALUES (
      (entry->>'id')::uuid, NULLIF(entry->>'client_transaction_id',''),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'source_type',''),'sale'),
      (s->>'id')::uuid, NULL, NULLIF(entry->>'member_id','')::uuid,
      NULLIF(s->>'store_id',''), NULLIF(entry->>'shift_id',''),
      NULLIF(entry->>'terminal_id',''), COALESCE((entry->>'amount')::numeric,0),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'method',''),'cash'), COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'kind',''),'payment'),
      NULLIF(entry->>'reference',''), NULLIF(entry->>'cashier_id',''), NULLIF(entry->>'cashier_name',''),
      COALESCE(entry->>'note',''), COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'paid_at','')::timestamptz,now()),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'created_at','')::timestamptz,now()),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'status',''),'completed'), COALESCE(entry->'metadata','{}'::jsonb)
    ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  END LOOP;

  FOR entry IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(_movements,'[]'::jsonb)) LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.item_activity_logs (
      id, product_id, product_name, sku, barcode, store_id, terminal_id,
      activity_type, reference, quantity_delta, stock_before, stock_after,
      unit_cost, staff_id, staff_name, role, note, created_at
    ) VALUES (
      (entry->>'id')::uuid, NULLIF(entry->>'product_id','')::uuid, NULLIF(entry->>'product_name',''),
      NULLIF(entry->>'sku',''), NULLIF(entry->>'barcode',''), NULLIF(s->>'store_id',''),
      NULLIF(entry->>'terminal_id',''), entry->>'activity_type', NULLIF(entry->>'reference',''),
      COALESCE((entry->>'quantity_delta')::integer,0), NULLIF(entry->>'stock_before','')::integer,
      NULLIF(entry->>'stock_after','')::integer, COALESCE((entry->>'unit_cost')::numeric,0),
      NULLIF(entry->>'staff_id',''), NULLIF(entry->>'staff_name',''), NULLIF(entry->>'role',''),
      COALESCE(entry->>'note',''), COALESCE(NULLIF(entry->>'created_at','')::timestamptz,now())
    ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  END LOOP;

  FOR movement_result IN
    SELECT * FROM public.stock_apply_deltas(
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'movement_id', movement_entry.value->>'id',
        'product_id', movement_entry.value->>'product_id',
        'store_id', s->>'store_id',
        'delta', movement_entry.value->>'quantity_delta'
      )), '[]'::jsonb)
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(_movements,'[]'::jsonb)) AS movement_entry(value))
    )
  LOOP
    IF movement_result.status = 'refused' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_REFUSED: %', COALESCE(movement_result.reason,'failed')
        USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF NULLIF(_exchange_bill,'') IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.sales SET exchanged_to_bill_number = s->>'bill_number'
     WHERE bill_number = _exchange_bill AND COALESCE(store_id,'') = COALESCE(s->>'store_id','');
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', s->>'id', 'client_transaction_id', s->>'client_transaction_id');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pos_sync_aggregate_shift_closure_ack(p_operations jsonb, p_branch_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.pos_sync_shift_closure_ack(COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(incoming->>'store_id'),'') IS NULL
           OR lower(btrim(incoming->>'store_id'))=lower(btrim(p_branch_id))
      THEN incoming||jsonb_build_object('store_id',p_branch_id) ELSE incoming END),'[]'::jsonb),p_branch_id)
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_operations,'[]'::jsonb)) operation
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(operation->'rows','[]'::jsonb)) incoming
  WHERE operation->>'table'='shifts'
$function$

definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pos_sync_assert_shift_ownership(p_rows jsonb, p_branch_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NULLIF(btrim(p_branch_id),'') IS NULL OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) incoming
    WHERE NULLIF(btrim(incoming->>'store_id'),'') IS NULL
       OR lower(btrim(incoming->>'store_id'))<>lower(btrim(p_branch_id))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_BRANCH_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;
  -- A globally unique id does not authorize moving an existing shift between shops.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.shifts,COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) incoming
    JOIN public.shifts existing ON existing.id=incoming.id
    WHERE existing.store_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_branch_id
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_BRANCH_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pos_sync_shift_closure_ack(p_rows jsonb, p_branch_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE incoming public.shifts%ROWTYPE; persisted public.shifts%ROWTYPE; confirmed jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Match the established request-boundary canonicalization, including replay.
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(row_value->>'store_id'),'') IS NULL
    OR lower(btrim(row_value->>'store_id'))=lower(btrim(p_branch_id))
    THEN row_value||jsonb_build_object('store_id',p_branch_id) ELSE row_value END),'[]'::jsonb)
  INTO p_rows FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) row_value;
  PERFORM public.pos_sync_assert_shift_ownership(p_rows,p_branch_id);

-- Only a clean, otherwise identical opening can be acknowledged as obsolete.
-- Different notes/opening facts or submitted counts remain pending for review.
-- Receipt replay skips the upsert: validate nonfinal rows against a stable
-- parent without waiting behind a multi-parent writer in another lock order.
-- A busy parent is transient, never an acknowledgement. Pure CLOSED proof
-- requests retain their existing lock path.
IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.shifts,COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) candidate
  WHERE NOT (COALESCE(candidate.status,'')='CLOSED' AND COALESCE(candidate.state,'')='CLOSED'
             AND candidate.closed_at IS NOT NULL)
) THEN
  BEGIN
    PERFORM locked_row.id
    FROM public.shifts locked_row
    JOIN jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.shifts,COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) input_scope
      ON input_scope.id=locked_row.id
    WHERE locked_row.store_id=p_branch_id
    ORDER BY locked_row.id FOR SHARE OF locked_row NOWAIT;
  EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='55P03', MESSAGE='SYNC_SHIFT_CLOSURE_BUSY';
  END;
END IF;
IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.shifts,COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) opening_row
  JOIN public.shifts closed_row ON closed_row.id=opening_row.id
  WHERE closed_row.store_id=p_branch_id
    AND (upper(COALESCE(closed_row.status,''))='CLOSED'
         OR upper(COALESCE(closed_row.state,''))='CLOSED' OR closed_row.closed_at IS NOT NULL)
    AND NOT (COALESCE(opening_row.status,'')='CLOSED' AND COALESCE(opening_row.state,'')='CLOSED'
             AND opening_row.closed_at IS NOT NULL)
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(opening_row.status,'OPEN')='OPEN' AND COALESCE(opening_row.state,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE'
      AND opening_row.closed_at IS NULL
      AND opening_row.closed_by_name IS NULL AND opening_row.closed_by_staff_id IS NULL
      AND opening_row.closed_by_role IS NULL AND opening_row.counted_cash IS NULL
      AND opening_row.counted_card IS NULL AND opening_row.counted_digital IS NULL
      AND opening_row.closing_float IS NULL AND opening_row.final_counted_cash IS NULL
      AND opening_row.variance_cash IS NULL AND opening_row.variance_card IS NULL
      AND opening_row.variance_digital IS NULL AND opening_row.variance_total IS NULL
      AND opening_row.variance_status IS NULL AND opening_row.close_reason IS NULL
      AND opening_row.closing_started_at IS NULL AND opening_row.closing_started_by IS NULL
      AND (to_jsonb(opening_row) - ARRAY[
        'status','state','closed_at','closed_by_name','closed_by_staff_id','closed_by_role',
        'counted_cash','counted_card','counted_digital','expected_cash','expected_card','expected_digital',
        'closing_float','final_counted_cash','variance_cash','variance_card','variance_digital',
        'variance_total','variance_status','close_reason','closing_started_at','closing_started_by',
        'row_version','updated_at']::text[])
        = (to_jsonb(closed_row) - ARRAY[
        'status','state','closed_at','closed_by_name','closed_by_staff_id','closed_by_role',
        'counted_cash','counted_card','counted_digital','expected_cash','expected_card','expected_digital',
        'closing_float','final_counted_cash','variance_cash','variance_card','variance_digital',
        'variance_total','variance_status','close_reason','closing_started_at','closing_started_by',
        'row_version','updated_at']::text[])
    )
) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_SHIFT_CLOSURE_CONFLICT'; END IF;
  FOR incoming IN
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.shifts,COALESCE(p_rows,'[]'::jsonb)) candidate
    WHERE upper(COALESCE(candidate.status,''))='CLOSED'
       OR upper(COALESCE(candidate.state,''))='CLOSED' OR candidate.closed_at IS NOT NULL
  LOOP
    SELECT * INTO persisted FROM public.shifts WHERE id=incoming.id FOR SHARE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR persisted.store_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_branch_id
       OR incoming.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CLOSED' OR incoming.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'CLOSED'
       OR incoming.closed_at IS NULL OR incoming.row_version IS NULL OR incoming.row_version<1
       OR persisted.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CLOSED' OR persisted.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'CLOSED'
       OR persisted.row_version IS NULL OR persisted.row_version<1
       OR ROW(persisted.closed_at,persisted.closed_by_name,persisted.closed_by_staff_id,persisted.closed_by_role,
              persisted.counted_cash,persisted.counted_card,persisted.counted_digital,
              persisted.expected_cash,persisted.expected_card,persisted.expected_digital,
              persisted.closing_float,persisted.variance_cash,persisted.variance_card,persisted.variance_digital,
              persisted.variance_total,persisted.close_reason,persisted.closing_started_at,
              persisted.closing_started_by,persisted.final_counted_cash,persisted.variance_status)
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          ROW(incoming.closed_at,incoming.closed_by_name,incoming.closed_by_staff_id,incoming.closed_by_role,
              incoming.counted_cash,incoming.counted_card,incoming.counted_digital,
              incoming.expected_cash,incoming.expected_card,incoming.expected_digital,
              incoming.closing_float,incoming.variance_cash,incoming.variance_card,incoming.variance_digital,
              incoming.variance_total,incoming.close_reason,incoming.closing_started_at,
              incoming.closing_started_by,incoming.final_counted_cash,incoming.variance_status)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_SHIFT_CLOSURE_CONFLICT'; END IF;
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(confirmed) previous WHERE previous->>'id'=incoming.id::text)
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_SHIFT_CLOSURE_DUPLICATE'; END IF;
    confirmed:=confirmed||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',persisted.id,'store_id',persisted.store_id,'row_version',persisted.row_version,'requested_row_version',incoming.row_version));
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('shift_closure_ack_version',2,'shift_closures',confirmed);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pos_sync_validate_read_scope(p_organization_id text, p_branch_id text, p_terminal_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF auth.role()='service_role' AND p_organization_id='default'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stores WHERE id=p_branch_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.terminal_tokens WHERE id::text=p_terminal_id
   AND platform='pc' AND location_id IS NULL AND management_sync_enabled
   AND is_claimed AND status IN ('active','used') AND revoked_at IS NULL) THEN RETURN; END IF;
 PERFORM public.pos_sync_validate_scope(p_organization_id,p_branch_id,p_terminal_id);
END $function$

definitions.name: pos_sync_validate_scope
definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pos_sync_validate_scope(p_organization_id text, p_branch_id text, p_terminal_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'default' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_ORGANIZATION_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;
 IF NULLIF(btrim(p_branch_id),'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(p_terminal_id),'') IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_TERMINAL_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.terminal_tokens t WHERE t.id::text=p_terminal_id AND t.location_id=p_branch_id AND t.status IN ('active','used') AND t.revoked_at IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNC_TERMINAL_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN'; END IF;
END $function$
